oai_dc:dc.dc:title: SOP 04 Setting up an experimental design using the Taguchi approach for bioanalytical method development
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Elena Gregoris
Alice Franchin
Marco Roman
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for applying the Taguchi experimental design method as an efficient approach to bioanalytical method development. The Taguchi method minimizes the number of experiments needed while maintaining a robust understanding of how variables affect the quality of the method. This document was prepared by the team of the research project "Integrated systemic detection of pollutants in the human body" (INSYDE-HU), n. P2022RJCHC, CUP: H53D23010450001, funded by funded by the PRIN 2022 framework of the Italian National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR).
